name: eMACS J2229.9-0808 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J2229.9-0808, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj222990808a-hubble
story: The gravity of this cluster bends the light of a more distant galaxy into Hamilton's Object, a set of stretched streaks that appear as mirror images of each other.

claims.text: eMACS J2229.9-0808 is a massive galaxy cluster targeted by Hubble program 13671
eMACSJ2229.9-0808 is an X-ray cluster that lenses a bright gravitational arc
Hamilton's Object is a gravitationally lensed image in the field of eMACS J2229.9-0808A, also cataloged as RM J223013.1-080853.1, observed by program GO-13671
Hamilton's Object is stretched streaks of a lensed galaxy appearing as mirror images
